text:
𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝟯-𝟭! 🇮🇳🔥

India defended 209 to beat NZ by 22 runs in the 5th ODI.
Arshdeep took 3/30; Axar and Kishan made 46 each.
First ODI series win in NZ since 2018-19.

Player of the series? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia
